summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude reimbursements for the remediation of PFAS contamination from an individual's gross income, applying to reimbursements received in tax years beginning after December 31, 2020.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude PFAS remediation reimbursements from gross income, which effectively lowers the tax burden for individuals receiving such reimbursements. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

The bill creates a new tax exclusion for PFAS remediation reimbursements, directly reducing federal tax revenue. This is the sole purpose of the legislation, so the measure has a modest but unambiguous effect of increasing the deficit to provide this tax relief.
